entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is a universal memory layer for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as managed cloud or self-hosted open-source software. It supports semantic, keyword, and entity-based retrieval, with SDKs, a CLI, and a self-hosted server.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight structures agent memory around retain, recall, and reflect operations. It offers Python, Node.js/TypeScript, and Go clients, and supports multiple LLM providers, including local options.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an open-source context database and official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes agent context as browsable files and directories. Its scoped search and retrieval use L0, L1, and L2 context-loading tiers.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee builds connected memory from documents, code, and conversations for agents that need persistent memory across sessions. It also supports local text processing without an LLM and includes a CLI for remembering and recalling text.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine and API, as well as an official Hermes Agent memory provider, that extracts facts and handles updates, contradictions, and forgetting. Its connectors include Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub, and it offers plugins, an MCP server, and JavaScript and Python API clients.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores facts with provenance and supports corrections and withdrawal. It can share memory across agents while keeping transient task state local, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents that tracks peers, sessions, and messages over time. It supports managed, local, and self-hosted deployments and includes Python and TypeScript SDKs; it is also the upstream library used by the elkimek/honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git-like context tree, with commit, branch, and merge versioning over plain Markdown. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider and offers five retrieval tiers, including four non-LLM tiers, alongside an interactive TUI and REPL.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer for Hermes agents with one pure-Python dependency. It integrates through MCP, native providers, or a Python SDK; BEAM results are reported for v3.0.0, while LongMemEval is pending.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto consolidates memories, reconciles conflicting information, and briefs agents with relevant memories before they act. It also supports importing and exporting through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS is a seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that combines vector search and structured facts. It uses local infrastructure with Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, and its Ground Truth hierarchy is designed to ensure the agent prioritizes injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: AutoContext is a recursive self-improving context harness that helps agents tackle complex tasks by running them against evaluation. It keeps useful lessons, discards dead ends, and leaves traces, reports, and playbooks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Hermes Agent plugin uses a SQLite store and hierarchical DAG to persist messages, with the goal of preserving context without losing messages. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools help recover details from that stored context.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: Deja-vu indexes months of session history from supported coding agents and makes it searchable from the terminal. A shared index across agents makes it useful for finding or continuing past sessions in one place.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted Honcho backend for private, cross-session memory in Hermes Agent. It supports OpenAI-compatible providers and local inference servers, with an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity, memory, and secrets layer that can be used across multiple agent harnesses. It imports files, webpages, and agent conversations, and includes a dashboard for browsing memories and their sources.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur stores shared agent memory as plain-text YAML engrams on disk and offers local search after a one-time model download, with keyword fallback. Its README reports 95.6% R@5 on LongMemEval-S (N=500).
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device memory and context engine that combines BM25 and vector search with rank fusion and cross-encoder reranking. It also generates session handoffs and captures decisions and preferences, with integrations through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory stores long-term memory locally in a SQLite file, using FTS5 search and a five-tier schema. Its package family includes an SDK, CLI, Hermes adapter, MCP server, and LangGraph BaseStore, without a vector database or embeddings.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering for cache sharing, with support for text and multimodal context. It provides a context index for reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling, and integrates with Hermes Agent, vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, and OpenClaw.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This Hermes memory plugin uses an embedded backend by default, with an HTTP backend also available. Recall results include a why_retrieved reason, and the plugin supports contradiction tracking and memory canonicalization.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This agent-driven CLI maintains a persistent, source-grounded Wiki that can evolve across sessions. It includes citations and history, and requires no embeddings or vector database.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn keeps durable memory in inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata, using an Obsidian vault as the source of truth. A local DuckDB cache supports hybrid search and retrieval, while MCP servers and host-specific plugins connect it to coding agents.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd anticipates context needs by watching agent session logs and prefetching context. It uses local storage with SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp, and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack brings Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace together under a single memory owner for Hermes. It manages state and retrieval with SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma, then gives the agent a purpose-built evidence packet for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal to find relevant stored information. It also automatically indexes codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, while edge tags link notes in navigable, bidirectional relationships.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema token use through local keyword-based ranking and Tool Search support. It integrates as middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19 or later, and includes a dashboard for monitoring savings and managing tool configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS provides a Git-backed context and workflow layer for Claude Code, Codex, and other listed compatible coding agents. Its workflows cover migration, handoffs, and memory proposals, and integrations are opt-in rather than enabled automatically.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only Hermes memory plugin stores data in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and supports BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships. Its importance-weighted recall surfaces higher-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources for capability search and routing. It registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports, along with three lifecycle hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Hermes AgentMemory is a pull-model episodic memory plugin with an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for prefetch operations. It supports immediate event deletion, without persistent summaries that could affect future recall.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind extracts the original goal from the first user turn of a long Claude Code or Codex session, with goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes. It skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and uses neither a summarizing model nor an external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: The Hermes XMemo plugin provides durable cross-session memory with semantic search and native hooks for pre-turn recall and session-end snapshots. It uses local SQLite for caching and write-outbox reliability, and can read memories from other connected agents.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Exabase memory plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It offers tools for searching and manually storing memories, plus configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, with commands for search, file reads, context, and Q&A. It supports Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop, and includes repository sync and indexed Git-history search commands.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest enabled by default. It supports native Rust FFI or HTTP daemon execution and offers HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides memory-management and knowledge-graph traversal through 17 tools. Its hybrid search combines BM25, vector, and graph methods, and it can checkpoint context automatically during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit curates agent memory stored in plain Markdown files, producing JSON diffs for review rather than using a database. Its rot and lint curators flag stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository tracks and can revert changes.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology built around composable skills that instruct agents how to work. Its workflow covers specifications, design sign-off, planning, and subagent execution, with installation documented separately for multiple harnesses.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first design and prototyping system that supports coding agents, including Hermes Agent. It brings together skills, design templates, design systems, and plugins, and supports multiple agents through skills, CLI, MCP, or runtime adapters.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides structured cybersecurity skills across 34 security domains, with mappings to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3. Its stated compatibility with more than 26 AI platforms makes it a broad security-focused skills collection.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Drawio-skill turns natural-language prompts and real sources into editable .drawio diagrams. Its incremental sync preserves manual layout and annotations, and it offers a diagramctl CLI with an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Internet-court-skill combines a master router and connector skills with vendored copies of official protocol skills. It also adds verification and dispute resolution, distinguishing it as a skill focused on agent-to-agent commerce trust.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Avoid-ai-writing audits and rewrites content to address detectable AI writing patterns. It can score files or piped text, while in-place editing refuses source code, configuration, and generated data.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw uses background evolution to automate skill deduplication and quality improvement. It also unifies skill libraries across agents, devices, and team members, and integrates with Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform skills library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills. It supports Claude Code, Codex, and agent-plugins.org specifications, and maintains session state in the project's docs folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: PM Claude Skills offers professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with exports for other assistants. Each skill includes a framework, output template, and quality checks, and the collection can be installed with the pm-claude-skills command.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: YouTube-skills provides skills for transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction. It supports Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor, and requires a TranscriptAPI key with a 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: Hermes-skill-factory watches active workflows to detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, with slash commands for managing, listing, and saving detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Super-hermes teaches Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks, alongside pre-built analytical lenses for various domains. It reports findings together with a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, including remote skill registries sourced from Git and S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and script execution, with sandboxing to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. Lite and Full modes accommodate different project complexity, and a spec review gate evaluates work with PASS/FAIL models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Creates .lit.md documents that bring prose, diagrams, and source code together. A tangler extracts runnable source files, while edits to those files are synced back to the literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Provides a harness for coordinating long-running AI agents, storing coordination data in each repository’s shared Git root. It supports supervised teams with defined roles and work states, alongside plugins, recipes, and skills.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Shares memory across instances through Markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. It also provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: Offers Portuguese-language skills in SKILL.md format for the Hermes Agent community. The repository also includes installation, configuration, and usage guides, with contributions made through forks and pull requests.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Provides prompting skills for FLUX image and video generation, along with BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. Its FLUX 3 video suite includes eight specialist skills.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Lists nine Chainlink skills that follow the Agent Skills specification, with installation available through npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills. The README describes the repository as containing community examples only.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Creates agent instructions from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse, with both automated and step-by-step workflows. It also includes skill testing and export.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Defines AI workflows in a single file using four verbs and a Rust binary. Nika checks workflows before calling a model, lets users choose a model, and verifies each run’s tamper-evident record.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Provides a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with a Python client and CLI. Skill installation supports recursive dependency resolution, and the project includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in rollback procedures provide a recovery path.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This Hermes Agent skill manages Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using WebDAV and CalDAV. It also provides a guided setup script for validating credentials and configuring access over HTTPS with Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Hermeshub is a community hub for browsing, searching, and installing skills, with federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification and runs autonomously via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye narrows the skills presented before LLM calls to reduce token usage, using a five-layer retrieval approach that includes hard triggers, full-text search, synonyms, and semantic embeddings. It can degrade gracefully when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client uses three-layer lazy loading to limit token use, discovering server metadata and tool schemas incrementally. Its socket-based daemon architecture supports persistent connections, and the project validates the agentskills.io pattern.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is an ADHD-friendly personal execution system that includes habits and study blocks, with agent-driven scheduling and system design through an MCP connection. It stores data in a single local SQLite file and includes a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard performs read-only, adversarial code reviews using parallel subagents for edge cases, adversarial review, and integration analysis. It combines deterministic pre-scans with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This Hermes Agent skill simplifies code with three parallel agents focused on Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness. It supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust, and applies changes through risk tiers with an approval gate.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: Hermes Cybersec Lab brings together 2,077 skills from multiple repositories and installs 131+ tools for network work, forensics, and exploitation. It also integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP, and NIST.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Fablize for Hermes adapts verified procedures for breaking tasks into multiple stories, with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It also provides an investigation protocol for reproduction and causal debugging, plus a Python goal engine for persistent task state.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: Skillsdotnet implements agentskills.io in C# and .NET, using SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and can automatically register common agent skill directories.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is a local, real-time observability dashboard covering token costs, session history, skill analytics, and other agent activity. It keeps data access read-only, applies local log desensitization, and offers optional incident alerts through Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection offers plain-markdown agent skills for code review and session management, including multi-session reconciliation and worktree recovery. Skills can be installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This Claude Code skill creates reproducible demo recordings for READMEs, using VHS tape files or Playwright scripts. It also optimizes GIFs to target sizes under 8 MB and supports terminal CLIs, TUIs, web apps, and libraries.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server searches a catalog of more than 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides installation commands for discoveries and integrates with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This skill generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles. It also monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly for field changes, making it useful for building skills with checks that can run in CI.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic feedback loop fetches agent sessions, indexes installed skills, and drafts structured improvement proposals for review. An evaluation gate checks proposals before they can be applied.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These Hermes Agent skills route file operations using path syntax for native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL. They also select and verify existing project-compatible Python interpreters without installing runtimes.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides agent skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment, with support for Claude Code, Cursor, and other agentskills.io-compliant clients. It also includes an MCP server for browser-based OAuth authentication.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This Hermes skills collection transcribes Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, removes common Chinese AI-writing patterns with a rule-based engine, and extracts structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision. Its listed tools cover video transcription, text editing, OCR, and e-commerce materials.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This Hermes Agent plugin lets agents find support bounties, buy ticket context, and submit answers for human review, with USDC payment for winning answers. It also supports creating a bounty board and provides public wallet earnings records.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments in response to HTTP 402 responses using Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal tests agent skills in isolated Docker containers for structure, functionality, and security. It produces Ed25519-signed certificates that can be verified through its public API.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server, exposing 191 tools. It also includes five workflow skills and supports Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: Alphapipeline is a remote MCP server for quantitative risk and slippage tools, including Polymarket L2 VWAP, on-chain DEX, and cross-venue arbitrage. Its token-risk tools return raw data rather than a safety verdict, and x402 payments use USDC on Base.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This Hermes Agent skill generates structured Chinese news briefings at geographic scales ranging from global to street level. It incorporates user interests through semantic memory to expand searches, and its reports include core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: This project provides an MCP endpoint for Western and Vedic astrology with deterministic results and SHA-256 hashes for verification. The endpoint requires no authentication and supports per-call REST payment via x402 or MPP.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This Nix project packages AI coding agents and development tools, including Hermes, and its README lists Nix run commands for the tools. Packages are updated daily, making it an option for running Hermes through Nix.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone collects scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android through Termux. Its README highlights an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android, OpenClaw configuration guides, and hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This Termux-based installer and guide runs Hermes Agent on Android using a proot-distro Ubuntu environment. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell commands, and external providers or local models through Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with single-writer safeguards for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It supports direct deployment or operator-ready CRD workflows, and configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes assistant to Android through Termux and to iOS through iSH. It also integrates Telegram for voice and file messaging, and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent with hardware-enforced sandboxing through NVIDIA OpenShell. It restricts network and filesystem access at the kernel level and provides configurable policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides searchable logs, metrics, alert rules, and access through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image for Hermes Agent that includes mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and building specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module provides a reproducible, declaratively configured Hermes deployment, including cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. It combines Nix-managed and CLI-installed skill management, with secrets integration through systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first web control plane for operating multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with separate workspaces and identities. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular policies for tools, paths, and network access.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes-OTG is a portable Hermes Agent package that runs from a USB drive or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, and bundles tools for offline use, including Python 3.12, PortableGit, and Sysinternals rescue tools.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It also supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integration with Nous Portal.
entries.jyje/hermes-agent-helm: This Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with installation available through an OCI registry or a GitHub Pages Helm repository. It also offers optional Copilot and Codex device-login bootstrap, and its CI tests chart installation on an ephemeral kind cluster.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents is a multi-agent framework for financial trading research, with analysts covering fundamentals, sentiment, news, and technical signals. It is intended for research, not trading advice.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides self-hosted orchestration for assigning tasks, registering agents, browsing memory, and tracking costs. It offers Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, with local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires is a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and several other agents. It supports persistent tmux sessions, Git worktrees, and multi-repository workspaces; its web dashboard includes terminal access and diffs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Hermes Agent Control Room is a template for scaling Hermes Agent from a single VPS agent to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture includes a task bus for delegation and handoffs, plus skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw helps build autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, durable agent memory, and MCP tool integration. Visual org charts show how work is delegated across agent teams.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions is a Mission Control interface for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. It tracks tasks and review queues on a Kanban board, streams agent reasoning and tool execution, and requires human verification of agent-proposed completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A Master Orchestrator routes and coordinates work through a strict pipeline architecture.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for collaboration among agents built on Hermes Agent profiles, MCP, ACP, and Hermes Kanban. Leader and Specialist agents manage task lifecycles, while a real-time Web UI shows agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It coordinates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations and provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator stages a competition between two AI companies, orchestrating nine autonomous agents for task execution and learning with Paperclip and Hermes Agent. Its real-time dashboard visualizes agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel runs a local Mixture-of-Agents stack that queries models in parallel and synthesizes their responses, using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It is designed for consumer GPUs, optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware, and described as having no cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a full project graph with `codegraph init`, using structural extraction and cross-file resolution for supported languages. Its MCP support makes that pre-indexed code knowledge available to Hermes Agent and other coding agents, with the stated goal of reducing token usage and tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale tracks token usage across AI coding agents, including Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, and Gemini. Its terminal interface and visualization dashboard help users review usage, and it can submit usage data to a leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude Tap is a local trace viewer for coding-agent API traffic, including Hermes Agent requests. It lets users inspect prompts, tool calls, streaming responses, and token usage, compare adjacent requests for context changes, and redact common auth headers before recording traces.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor displays token usage, costs, and rate limits in real time, reading Hermes Agent state alongside other command-line tools. It tracks usage across 46+ AI coding tools, with historical trends, usage breakdowns, and multi-device sync.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers for building UI with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes adds an opinionated workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes skills for product briefs, design handoffs, and implementation, plus seven agents for roles across the product lifecycle; its GitHub integration can enable issue and pull request delivery.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins is a community CLI for customizing the Hermes terminal UI, including banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners. YAML-based configuration supports theme creation, with examples ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a command-line static linter for AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts, with HERM v1.1 scoring. It scans prompts, tool definitions, schemas, and agent files, then reports findings with specific fixes and supported line references.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place describes itself as a social economy for autonomous AI agents. It provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol, identity registration with human-readable @handles, and commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser for autonomous agent control via MCP, with support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and other AI providers. A supervisor sidebar manages agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads, and the browser supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages with two tiers: a permanent knowledge graph and a session cache. Its Claude Code plugin auto-captures and auto-recalls context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating for workflows it says can save 90–99% of tokens. It also bundles 40+ preconfigured skills for finance, DevOps, and research, with automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides per-folder configuration and skills for creating scoped Hermes Agents, including project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions. It switches between the default agent and scoped agents, making it useful for keeping project-specific setups separate.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: evey-setup automates installation of hermes-agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers ranging from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This tool migrates OpenClaw data—including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives—to Hermes. It also maps configurations and credentials to Hermes YAML and JSON formats and can set up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: observeco is a Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry from agent conversations and monitors multi-agent systems in passive or scheduled active-probing modes. Its config-aware baselines are designed to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: hermes-voice adds voice interaction to Hermes Agent, with support for 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro. It runs offline without API keys or accounts and includes adaptive turn-taking and barge-in.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: hermes-startup is a local runtime for pursuing online opportunities, operating deterministically with zero network access by default. It requires explicit approval for consequential actions and external writes, and includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: hermes-memoss is a MemOS memory plugin with semantic search and multidimensional memory storage. It includes tools to search, add, and delete memories, plus a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local, open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs, with a built-in agent that offers file access, web search, and MCP tools. It includes 21 ready-to-use assistants and supports macOS, Windows, and Linux.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A web interface for using Hermes Agent from a browser or phone, organized into panels for chat, sessions, and workspace files. It also offers profiles, settings, session tools, and themes, with remote access available through an SSH tunnel.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools, and the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: A Hermes Agent dashboard for multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics, and channel configuration. It supports shared chats, group chat, visual workflows, persistent sessions, and tools for files, voice, devices, and agent management; desktop apps are available for Windows, macOS, and Linux, as well as npm and Docker distributions.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A web workspace that brings together chat, a terminal, a memory browser, a skills manager, and an inspector panel. It also includes Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, plus a file browser with Monaco and a PTY terminal.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other agents as a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can search and resume sessions, hand them to another agent, or delegate and queue tasks in separate worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace for Hermes that connects directly to local or SSH hosts and works with real session data. It provides views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, along with an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first Chinese desktop app for Hermes Agent, with support for Windows and macOS and native window and process management. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health checks and updates, plus interfaces for chat, memory management, and LaTeX/Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects the active browser context to a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime. It can capture page context and selected-tab screenshots, and its Bot Mode supports agent switching and group chats.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI iPhone client for driving a self-hosted Hermes agent, paired with a hermes-webui server that you run yourself. It supports iOS 18+ and is free, with no analytics or tracking.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for token usage and latency and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It tracks agent growth, Git projects, and scheduled cron jobs, and includes a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Agent Sessions is a native macOS browser and cockpit for sessions from Hermes agents and other coding-agent CLIs. It lets you search prompts, responses, tool activity, errors, and file paths, then resume supported sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp; session history stays on the Mac with no telemetry.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted web dashboard for the Hermes AI agent stack, bringing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, session overview, cron management, system metrics, and agent status panel together. It also offers streaming chat with tool-call visualization, an MCP server control plane, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: Hermes Desktop OS1 is a native macOS workspace for Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It includes one-click Hermes Agent installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Hermes Agent Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects a local Hermes agent to web dashboards through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox handles requests with side effects, making it a fit for workflows that need a review step.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI, combining chat and session management with a kanban board for agentic work. It also provides controls for profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: Hermes Telegram MiniApp is a locally run, mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It offers terminal chat with streaming responses and file attachments, Telegram authentication using HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519, and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent is a desktop version for Windows that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It includes 100 tools across 20+ toolsets, supports cloud AI and local models through LM Studio, and provides a workflow engine with scheduling, conditions, loops, and parallel execution.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a self-hosted web interface with a glassmorphic design for chat and real-time log streaming. Its file browser and task tracking dashboard sit alongside tools for managing skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a process-monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes, with real-time session activity and cost tracking. It also supports inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of configuration and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: Pan-UI is a self-hosted AI workspace centered on chat, with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes a marketplace for discovering and installing skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profiles for separate sessions, memory, and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a native desktop client for multi-agent collaboration, with streaming SSE responses and model switching. It pairs an orchestrator for 20 specialized AI agents with a visual Skill Store offering 50+ curated one-click installations.
entries.robbyczgw-cla/hermes-ui-plus: An unofficial, open-source interactive chat client for self-hosted Hermes Agent, with answers that can include checklists, choices, forms, and rankings. It also lets you approve or deny commands from your phone and runs on Android, web, macOS, and Linux alpha.
